author: reek
body: The dot is inside an act block deliberately, and the test is worthless anywhere else. At the top level the def parser takes the error node and moves on, so a stray dot there merely reports CDX2000 and this test would pass against the very compiler it exists to catch. The act statement loop is the caller that loops on the state it is handed back.

author: reek
body: The real-world trigger was an act block left unclosed, which makes that same loop read the prose beneath it as code and meet the period ending an English sentence. This is that dot, reduced.
